"""Bounded simulator-only refinement after a verified fresh regression receipt."""
import hashlib,json,subprocess
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
from emet.rl.regression_gate import verify_regressions
from emet.rl.manipulation.hold_experiment import training_command

receipt=Path('paper/data/whole_body_control/hold-cartesian-final-v5-regressions-20261025.receipt.json')
verified=verify_regressions(receipt)
spec_path=Path('configs/benchmarks/mars_hold_training_feedback_v5.json')
spec=json.loads(spec_path.read_text())
assert spec['steps']==65536 and spec['eval_every']==8192
out=Path('logs/manipulation/tamp-pose-precision-v9')
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
source=spec['initializers']['tracking_feedback']
command=training_command(spec,out,source,'offline')
launch={'format':'mars-pose-research-launch-v1','started_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        'source_revision':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),
        'spec':spec,'spec_sha256':hashlib.sha256(spec_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        'command':command,'output':str(out),'regression_receipt':str(receipt),
        'regression_receipt_sha256':hashlib.sha256(receipt.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        'regression_tests':len(verified['test_ids']),'cpu_affinity':[14],
        'completed_steps_at_launch':0,'training_complete':False,'safety_promoted':False,
        'scope':'Research refinement only; no hardware, online W&B, model upload or checkpoint promotion',
        'source_weights_sha256':json.loads((Path(source)/'manifest.json').read_text())['weights_sha256'],
        'driver_source':Path(__file__).read_text()}
(out/'launch.json').write_text(json.dumps(launch,indent=2)+'\n')
(out/'command.json').write_text(json.dumps(command,indent=2)+'\n')
(out/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec,indent=2)+'\n')
Path('paper/data/whole_body_control/pose_precision_refinement_v5_launch.json').write_text(json.dumps(launch,indent=2)+'\n')
print('REGRESSION_VERIFIED',len(verified['test_ids']),'START',str(out),flush=True)
with (out/'train.log').open('w') as log:
 result=subprocess.run(command,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
(out/'exit.json').write_text(json.dumps({'returncode':result.returncode,'finished_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()})+'\n')
print('TRAIN_RETURN',result.returncode,flush=True)
raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
